daily.today_energy: Mercury's vibes are asking you to pause and listen more than you speak. There's wisdom in the quiet moments today—trust what your intuition is trying to tell you beneath the noise.
daily.love: Someone's been thinking about reaching out to you. The energy suggests vulnerability creates connection right now. If you've been holding back, today feels like the day to be real with someone who matters.
daily.career: Your attention to detail is your superpower today, but don't get lost in the weeds. Step back and see the bigger picture—there's an opportunity hiding in plain sight that only you can spot.
daily.health: Your nervous system could use some grounding. Whether it's a walk, tea, or just five minutes of silence, give yourself permission to slow down. Your body's been sending signals; today's the day to actually listen.

weekly.overview: This week's energy invites you to trust your gut more than your spreadsheets. Mercury's moving through your sector of intuition, so those random ideas hitting at 2am? Write them down. Something's shifting beneath the surface, and you're picking up on it before anyone else.
weekly.love: Whether you're coupled up or solo, there's a vibe of authentic connection floating around. If you've been keeping feelings bottled, this is your gentle nudge to be real with someone. No games, no overthinking—just honest conversations that actually matter.
weekly.career: Your professional energy is giving quiet confidence. You don't need to prove anything this week; just do the work that actually feels meaningful to you. New opportunities might whisper instead of shout, so stay alert. Your competence is your superpower.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for slower, more intentional movement. Think less intense gym sessions, more stretching and walks where you can actually think. Sleep's calling you harder than usual—listen to it. This is your system asking for gentleness, not punishment.
